goal:
T86 — polish from the cloud review (2026-10-30). Web only; keep Codex's canvas design language and 375px fit.
1. No hardcoded Korean in apps/web/app/[locale]/**/*.tsx or components/*.tsx (except LanguageSwitcher's "한국어"):
   move every string (24 in app/[locale]/arena/page.tsx, e.g. "서버 합계 {cost}¢ · 출처 개별 확인", "결과 미확인", error
   texts) to messages (en + ko) — English pages must show English.
2. Dates follow the page locale: no toLocaleString()/toLocaleTimeString()/toLocaleDateString() without a locale, no
   Intl.DateTimeFormat('ko-KR' or undefined) — pass the next-intl locale (CanvasWorkspace run picker too; keep its
   Asia/Seoul time zone only for ko, UTC labelled for en is fine).
3. One language switcher per screen: header switcher desktop-only (wrap with "hidden md:..." classes); FeatureRail keeps
   exactly one <LanguageSwitcher> — in the mobile More menu — and drops the one in the desktop more menu.
4. A title per page: messages "titles" namespace (en + ko) with home, arena, replay, evidence, performance, verify,
   lab, evolution, leaderboard, share (no "Mission Control"); the [locale] layout uses titles.home; add
   app/[locale]/<route>/layout.tsx for each route above with generateMetadata reading titles.<route>
   (server components; pass children through).
5. Verify page: label text from messages (no hardcoded "Ed25519 signed", once only; no raw <dt>sealed</dt> /
   "{cert.sealed_count} (...)": when sealed_count is 0 show the held-out result the certificate carries, or omit);
   light theme like the rest (no dark inline backgrounds / bg-black / gray-900 classes).
6. Plain wording: Performance subtitle without "GET /api/evoforge/v1/performance"; replace "Harness adoption history"
   and "/1 -> /2" notation with sentences (e.g. "How the evaluation method was improved"); replace "Provider call path
   recorded · not independently verified" with an accurate, non-alarming line (e.g. "Model call recorded with its
   request receipt").
Keep every existing web test, apps/web/scripts/check-studio-render.mjs, tsc and next build green.
